title: TRIA site metadata schema
description: Schema for site-related metadata for a TRIA dataset

n_trees.title: Nr of trees
n_trees.description: Nr. of sampled trees at each site

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the site in decimal degrees (WGS84), e.g. 46.802361. Use a dot as decimal separator; southern hemisphere is negative.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude of the site in decimal degrees (WGS84), e.g. 9.835444. Use a dot as decimal separator; west of Greenwich is negative.

elevation.title: Elevation
elevation.description: Elevation of the site above sea level (in m)

aspect.title: Aspect
aspect.description: Direction the slope faces, in degrees clockwise from north (0-360), e.g. 0 = N, 90 = E, 180 = S, 270 = W. Leave empty for flat terrain.

slope.title: Slope
slope.description: Slope of the terrain at the site in degrees (0 = flat, 90 = vertical).

soil_depth.title: Soil depth
soil_depth.description: Depth of the soil at the site

soil_water_capacity.title: Soil water holding cap.
soil_water_capacity.description: Water holding capacity of the soil at the site

soil_moisture.title: Soil moisture
soil_moisture.description: Moisture level of soil at the site

stand_structure.title: Stand structure
stand_structure.description: Structural description of the forest stand

stand_age_str.title: Age structure
stand_age_str.description: Structure of the forest stand age

stand_age_class.title: Stand age
stand_age_class.description: Age class of the forest stand

stand_main_species_code.title: Main species
stand_main_species_code.description: Dominant tree species in the forest stand (ITRDB species code)

stand_management.title: Management
stand_management.description: Level of management applied at the site
